title: Oracle: the gateway's source_catalog message names CDB$ROOT, which fails

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: Oracle Free 23.26.3; the CLI version was not recorded

symptom: NO_CONNECTION_PARAMETER says to set source_catalog to the CDB$ROOT service name. The literal CDB$ROOT gives INGESTION_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ERROR.SOURCE_AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE ("Oracle service name 'CDB$ROOT' is invalid"). A source_catalog under gateway_definition is dropped by the CLI ("unknown field: source_catalog").
cause: The message gives a literal name, and the field belongs in connection_parameters.
effect: The gateway doesn't run with the literal name.
fix: Set connection_parameters to {"source_catalog": "<base service name>"} (FREE here).
